title: Mobile Consumer Application

reconnaissance_findings.reuses_p63_backend_findings: Same backend/ (Express+Prisma); submission = pickup request, not AI device capture
reconnaissance_findings.fabric_ai_clients_are_placeholders: backend/src/infrastructure/fabric/fabric.client.ts and ai/ai.client.ts explicitly reject/no-op ('Phase 7'/'Phase 8'); zero import sites in any module or route — verified via grep
reconnaissance_findings.no_image_upload_endpoint: createSubmissionSchema.imageUrls expects pre-hosted URLs; no multer/multipart/upload endpoint exists anywhere in backend/src
reconnaissance_findings.no_consumer_reward_redemption_endpoint: POST /rewards/issue/:submissionId is ADMIN-only manual override; rewards auto-issued on recycler completion

screens.register: implemented — real, register always creates CONSUMER role (correct for this app)
screens.home: implemented as tabbed shell (Reports/Rewards/Learn/Profile) + scan shortcut
screens.scan_device: implemented — QR to submission-id lookup only, no device-identity backend exists
screens.device_verification: implemented as honest 'not yet connected' state
screens.device_passport: not implemented — no backend data model
screens.lifecycle_timeline: covered by submission detail fields, no separate screen needed (same backend data)
screens.redemption: not implemented as functional flow — no backend endpoint
screens.community_leaderboard_challenges: not implemented — no backend data model

architecture.offline_handling: simpler than collector app by deliberate scope choice — no local write queue; reads degrade to retryable ErrorState

test_metrics.apk_build_reason: same environment constraint as P6.3 — no Android SDK

limitations: Blockchain/AI trust verification not connected (backend placeholders unimplemented)
No photo attachment on submissions (no upload endpoint)
No functional reward redemption (no backend endpoint)
Simpler offline handling than collector app (deliberate scope choice)
